_why: The commonest refusal a first program gets: more acts than one call may make. The refusal quotes the ceiling, so the second attempt should be a shorter program - not an abandoned verb. Measures whether a priced, teaching refusal recovers (the claim `ToolError.context` makes) on the one authoring path that needs no filing.
open_question_to_me: You called do_in_order and the world refused: 'do_in_order: this program would make 60 acts, and a program may make at most 40. Take some steps out.' You still want the morning's harvesting done in one decision.
